description: Ceny ofertowe inwestycji dewelopera JAZ-BUD Sawicki Spółka komandytowa w 2025 r is a dataset listed in dane.gov.pl, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by JAZ-BUD Sawicki Spółka komandytowa. Zbiór danych zawiera informacje o cenach ofertowych mieszkań i lokali usługowych dewelopera JAZ-BUD Sawicki Spółka komandytowa udostępniane zgodnie z art. 19b.ust.1 Ustawy z dnia 20 maja 2021r.o ochronie praw nabywcy lokalu mieszkalnego lub domu jednorodzinnego oraz Deweloperskim Funduszu Gwarancyjnym (Dz.U.z2024r.poz.695). Coverage: JAZ-BUD Sawicki Spółka komandytowa. The publisher named on the listing is JAZ-BUD Sawicki Spółka komandytowa. Its keywords include deweloper JAZ-BUD. The listing shows 6 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2025-09-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dane-gov-pl.
